svg.aria-label: From sampled poses to an energy: the restraint used in clash relief, the filtering funnel, average-linkage clustering with silhouette selection, the 262-feature affinity model, the AI-pose haircut, and the link between dG and Kd.
svg.text: Clash relief: harmonic restraint on heavy atoms
E = ½ k x², k = 50,000 kJ/mol/nm² = 500 kJ/mol/Å²
a 1 Å move costs ½·500·1² kJ/mol = 59.8 kcal/mol
the minimizer fixes overlaps, it cannot rearrange the pose
drop poses > 35 Å from the site
drop atom pairs closer than 1.5 Å
e.g. 82 of 100 poses survived the filters for MDM2 + p53 (CPU-only run)
k searched from 2 to min(15, ⌊n/5⌋); the maximum silhouette picks k*
silhouette s = (b − a) / max(a, b), averaged over poses
a: mean distance to own cluster; b: to the nearest other cluster
illustration on 82 synthetic poses, not measured data
Affinity model: 262 features into a gradient-boosted regressor
16 interface geometry: pocket composition, buried and hydrogen-bond
surface, aromatic contacts, Miyazawa–Jernigan energy, burial, gyration radius
220 = 22 residue-property scales × 10 aggregations of the peptide sequence
trained on 633 real RAPiDock poses · labels ΔG = RT ln Kd
a crystal-fitted model collapses on diffusion output (0.53 → 0.06);
training on generated poses recovers r ≈ 0.49–0.53
ΔG = RT ln Kd, and what an error of ±1.4 kcal/mol means
an error δ in ΔG changes Kd by a factor exp(δ/RT)
for the mean absolute error of 1.4 kcal/mol: exp(1.4 / 0.593) = 10.6
so a predicted ΔG of −9.5 kcal/mol (Kd about 110 nM) means
Kd between about 10 nM and 1.2 µM
LOCKR model: binder Kd = 100 pM, ΔG = −13.6 kcal/mol
which lies outside that band: the model ranks candidates
but cannot confirm a 100 pM binder without a measured Kd
